resources.string: Connect to a trusted Wi-Fi or Ethernet network.
AirPlay mirroring + audio · DLNA media playback
Experimental AirPlay compatibility. No Google Cast, Miracast, DRM or AirPlay 2 multiroom. Keep this app open; all receivers stop when you leave.
Use a trusted local network. Nearby devices on this network can request playback. Do not expose receiver ports to the Internet.
1 Start receiver\n2 Connect your phone to the same network\n3 Choose MoonCast TV in Screen Mirroring or a DLNA app
OK / Menu: show controls · Back: controls or exit · Media keys: playback
Smart cinema · detect and lock bars
Only selects existing Media3 tracks. AirPlay mirror requests are configured separately. Neither restores source detail.

AirPlay: real UxPlay-based video/audio receiver, experimental per iOS/device.
DLNA: SSDP discovery, AVTransport playback/seek, volume/mute and events.
Media: clear HTTP(S) MP4, HLS, DASH and device-supported audio/codecs via Media3.
Crop: proportional fit/fill/manual, sampled black-bar lock; dark frames are ignored.
Unsupported: Google Cast, Miracast, AirPlay 2 multiroom, DRM and proprietary app restrictions.
No physical iPhone/Android TV interoperability test is claimed.
GPLv3; upstream and source details are included with the GitHub release. Preview uses a debug signing key.
Up/down: select · Left/right: 1% (hold: 5%) · OK: save · Back: cancel · Menu: reset
Burned-in subtitles move with the picture. Crop carefully; Menu restores the whole image.
Saved by source and orientation; portrait defaults to full view.
Cinema locked · rescan for new content
Negotiation preference, not actual received resolution. Reconnect the sender after applying.
A real prebuffer, not signed A/V offset. More buffering may reduce dropouts but adds latency. Native signed audio offset is unavailable.
Only URL/HLS/DASH playback. Positive delays sound; negative skips initial PCM to advance sound. Applying restarts at the current position. Not an AirPlay mirror audio control.
Movie favors smoother playback. Low latency can stutter on weak networks. No measured end-to-end latency guarantee.
Current playback stops. Reconnect from the phone after the receiver is ready. Saved receiver identity is preserved.
Recover after control connections close and media remains silent. Static or paused video alone is not disconnection. Recovery keeps receiver identity and cannot force the phone to reconnect.
Without a PIN, LAN devices can request AirPlay access. Use only on a trusted private network.

This disconnects playback and permanently deletes this app receiver key and network identity. All senders must pair again; remove an old entry on the phone if needed. No per-device pairing list is available. Automatic recovery never does this.
Receiver identity reset. Pair again from the phone.
Session cleared; ready for a new connection
Sender name / per-device revocation unavailable. Session PIN keys are memory-only.
Identity reset failed; receiver stays stopped
Mirror request: %1$d × %2$d @ %3$d fps · audio prebuffer %4$d ms (0 = adaptive)
